cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

mechanism: Copy pulling a decorative ribbon without recognizing a support rope, then keep assigning each tent consequence to the original ribbon rather than A's actions.
confusable: Not generic blame shifting: the same early ribbon must explain each later effect while the mistaken copied pull is never admitted as confusion.
comparison: Tent support and a ruined cake differ from water spilled on a letter and readable consequences.
seedUse: Retains decorative ribbon/support rope/pull chain; adds imitation of a bow-untying action.
